purpose: test whether a predeclared compact capacity ladder preserves the five-trajectory fit-only compatibility result while reducing proposal inference cost
execution_order: run w16d2 first; stop if it passes 5/5; otherwise run w24d3 once
training_and_downstream: inherit v11.2 epochs, optimizer, loss, fit-only LOTO barrier, exact A^T, observable alpha, and strict CGLS K1
selection: choose the first 5/5 variant; no p45-s03 truth, stopping-validation truth, or untouched-test truth may select capacity
resource_followup: only the selected 5/5 variant may receive a full-fit checkpoint and observation-only runtime profiling
